text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, Messiah-san... I was looking through 
the photo album, and I found the pictures 
from when we went to Australia... *sniff*.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Sparkling seas, a hammock swaying in the 
breeze, basking in the bright sunshine! 
It's the absolute best~.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I see, remembering it made you miss it 
dearly, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Going to Australia right now isn't 
very realistic. If we could somehow adjust 
the schedule, perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I ended up troubling you with my 
selfishness. Please don't worry about it, 
Messiah-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, I believe for 
relaxation goods, a 'hammock,' 'marine 
blue aroma,' and 'healing ocean sounds 
music' were—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Shall we use all of those to bring the 
experience as close as possible to the one 
in Australia?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? There's a hammock!? That's just way 
too awesome!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm collecting things that make resting 
more meaningful. Can you make do with that 
for now?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Holding back? Not a chance! Hey, hey, when 
are we doing it? Hope it's sunny 
tomorrow~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please calm down. My 'Australia' 
isn't going anywhere.
